# Tether Link Utility

> Tether Link Utility is an Android app that shares a phone's mobile data with your laptop, tablet or another phone through a local SOCKS5 proxy shared over the phone's Wi-Fi hotspot. No root, no account, no remote server.

## What it does
- Runs entirely on-device: no remote server, no account required.
- Uses Android's VpnService API to run a local SOCKS5 proxy on the phone; connected devices send their traffic to that proxy and the phone forwards it over its mobile data connection.
- Free tier: connect up to 2 devices at once, with ads. Pro (paid): up to 5 devices at once, no ads.
- Works with Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS clients via standard SOCKS5 proxy settings.
- Android-to-Android connections are simplified via QR code scanning (usually one tap, no manual Wi-Fi setup).
- Data used by connected devices counts toward the phone's mobile plan; users should check their carrier's terms for tethering.

## Key facts
- Platform: Android app (the server/host device must be Android). Client devices can be Windows, macOS, Android, or iOS.
- Price: free to install and use with a 2-device limit and ads; Pro is $2.99/month or $12.99/year (USD reference, local prices vary by country) and removes ads and raises the device limit to 5. See https://tetherlinkutility.com/pricing.md
- Speed: actual speed depends on the carrier, plan and signal.
- Not a VPN or privacy service: it does not encrypt traffic or route it through any third-party server. All routing happens locally on the device.
- Privacy: routed traffic is never sent to our servers or logged by the proxy. The free version shows Google AdMob ads, and the ad provider may collect device identifiers. The app also uses Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Remote Config. The privacy policy explains the data types and how to request deletion.
